system.description:
Where Telepathy reads a single mind, Prediction keeps a channel open to everyone nearby — a constant background buzz of surface moods and attitudes. It is not a deep probe, but you sense a thought forming before it is spoken.

Anyone speaking with you must answer generic questions about their emotional state and attitude toward the topic truthfully ('What do you feel about this Praxis seizure?'), though not direct questions of intent. Lying to you is hard: every attempt to lie requires a Mental Challenge, ties going to you. If someone works a Subterfuge or similar Social Challenge on you, you may spend a Blood Trait and make a Mental Challenge to realise you are being swindled. You cannot be surprised within 10 feet unless your concentration is elsewhere or your faculties are impaired. Targets with eight or more Willpower Traits (or the Iron Will Merit) may consciously veil their thoughts, but must make a Simple Test to hold that veil if their concentration is disrupted, and only if they know you can read them.
